acceptance_predicates.description: Git staging is an admitted, typed, identity-bound capability and is not reachable through public generic dispatch.

The staging and commit boundary records intent before mutation and classifies injected staging or commit failure as failed or ambiguous-safe-mode without false success; factory-level process-death recovery remains AR-0114 scope.
A fresh real Git fixture completes all eight production phases through the admitted factory.
Independent exact-head review, hosted checks, post-merge checks, and state reconciliation pass.

definition_of_done: The Git staging seam is implemented without weakening fail-closed public mutation dispatch.
Real Git full-sequence evidence and lower-level durable failure tests pass independently; factory-level process-death recovery remains AR-0114 scope.
AR-0114 can consume the evidence and proceed toward AR-0009 and AR-0031 closure.

outputs.description: Reproducible real Git eight-phase and recovery evidence.

gates.description: Git path, branch, head, barrier, fencing, and session revision are rechecked before and during the effect.
